verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a recruiting SaaS like Dover, but the evidence never shows a conversational or command interface for running the product. The AI features shown are applicant scoring and generated careers pages and job descriptions, which are different capabilities. The API, the AI-tool integrations and llms.txt are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not natural-language control of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
